_readme: Recurring statutory due dates as data (AGENTS.md rule 4). These are the dates in the rules; the government often extends them by notification, which this file does not track. Not included (not verified under current rules): income-tax return due dates, GSTR-9/9C, GSTR-4, government deductors' TDS dates, TCS.
